SkillDefinition.description:
Represents an Agent Skill definition available to the GenAI agent or model.
Conforms to the Agent Skills specification (https://agentskills.io/specification).

name.description: The name of the Agent Skill.
name.title: Name

description.description: The description of the Agent Skill. Since this attribute could be large, it's NOT RECOMMENDED to be populated by default. Instrumentations MAY provide a way to enable populating this property.
description.title: Description

source_uri.description: The source URI or file path for loading the skill.
source_uri.title: Source Uri

compatibility.description: Environment and compatibility requirements for the skill.
compatibility.title: Compatibility

license.description: License name or reference to a bundled license file.
license.title: License

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata mapping defined in the skill frontmatter.
metadata.title: Metadata

SkillDefinition.title: SkillDefinition

description: Represents the list of skill definitions available to the GenAI agent or model.
title: SkillDefinitions
